prompt_inputs.goal: maintain performance and recovery with multiple training sessions

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks)
Provides balanced macronutrients suitable for a soccer player with moderate-to-high intensity training
Includes adequate carbohydrates and protein to support multiple training sessions and recovery
Plan is compact and concise (fits within a single day overview)
task_description: Write a single, compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a mixed-sport athlete (soccer player) with moderate intensity demands, balanced macronutrient needs, and multiple training sessions in one day

prompt_inputs.goal: muscle gain and strength improvement for weightlifting competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein is elevated (approximately 1.8-2.2g per kg body weight)
At least one substantial meal or snack is positioned within 2 hours post-training to support recovery
Plan is presented in a single, easy-to-scan format suitable for one day
task_description: Write a single, compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power sport athlete (weightlifter) needing elevated protein distribution and strategic nutrient timing around resistance training

prompt_inputs.goal: marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and optimal timing around a 2-hour long run session

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with breakfast, pre-run, during-run (if applicable), post-run, and dinner meals
Total daily carbohydrate intake is high (approximately 8-10g per kg body weight) to support endurance training
Pre-run meal is consumed 2-3 hours before the long run session and post-run meal includes carbohydrates and protein within 30-60 minutes after completion
Plan is compact and presented in a single, easy-to-read format
task_description: Write a single, compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around long training sessions
